about: The rules of spec/engine/levels.md: one shard of the BFBC2 tool suite specification's rule index, written by spec/trace.py --emit; checked by spec/trace.py --check.

evidence.ref: OPFOR's logged level catalogue: every level id Levels/<LV>; 74 stock levels each with a description in the startup bundles and bundles under levels/<lv>/

OPFOR's logged level catalogue of the stock levels: 10 BFBC2 maps with 2-4 mode levels each (MP_009 all four), Harvest Day and Oasis four each, Cold War three, Heavy Metal two, five Vietnam maps four each

rules.title: Each mode of a map is a level of its own

evidence.ref: stock package.mft: mode levels' level blocks target the base map's bundles after their own (MP_005GR -> MP_005); MP_005GR holds the shader databases, emitter system, model groups and cull trees under its own name

rules.title: A mode level loads its map's bundles after its own

evidence.ref: BFBC2Game.exe LevelData constructor 0x13A6DA0; HasAI tested at 0x575046 as byte [level+0x3AE

rules.title: The level data object at run time

evidence.ref: descriptions measured: Vietnam's levels MatchmakingModID VIETNAM, Licenses nam, KickIfLicenseMissing true, KIT_*_NAM; BFBC2's levels MatchmakingModID BC2 and no licence

rules.title: The description declares the level's content set

evidence.ref: OPFOR's records: a _NAME prefix mismatch gave a black loading screen; stock keys such as MP_009_NAME name mp_009's picture

rules.title: The loading picture is found by the name key
